title: HTTP service node
description: A service node of a package (schema/http-services/*.json): a path below the package, reachable under /<package ID in lower case>/<path>, with handler classes and settings that its subtree inherits.

path.description: Path below the package: segments of letters, digits, '.', '_', '~' and '-', starting with a letter or digit, separated by '/'. The empty path is the root node of the package.

handlers.description: Handler classes in the order they run; a node without handlers only groups.

class.description: A public class implementing /TRBASE/HTTP_HANDLER with a constructor without parameters.

settings.description: Settings of the node; each one that is left out is inherited from the parent node.

authentication.description: Allowed authentication methods: basic (user and password), token (API token) and session (the cookie of a browser session from /rt/session).

anonymousTenant.description: The tenant of anonymous requests; without it they have no tenant.

tenantSources.description: Where the tenant of a request comes from, in this order: the header X-Tenant, the query parameter tenant, the default tenant of the user, or the tenant of the browser session.

languageSources.description: Where the language of a request comes from, in this order: the query parameter lang, the header Accept-Language, the default language of the user, or the language of the browser session; English otherwise.

maxResponseSize.description: Largest response body that code writes, in bytes.

authorization.description: A check that requests with sign-in pass after the check of /TRBASE/HTTP_SERVICE, before the first handler; null makes no additional check for the node and its subtree.

object.description: An authorization object of the package, of a required package or of the kernel.

fields.description: A value for every field of the object, or {"any": true} to leave a field out.
